analysis: The only change in docs/architecture/inference.md is at head lines 1370-1382 (range_map_complete=true), outside the supplied units (head lines 1-797). That change adds documentation for Qwen inline MTP ordinary-decode history chaining and prefill carry. It also names rollback switches DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CHAINED and DARKBLOOM_TTFT_QWEN_MTP_CARRY. The supplied units contain unchanged surrounding text, which I examined for context. It covers: Nemotron Super prefix-bank scoping by authenticated tenant cache scope (lines 231-238, 521-524), relevant to T-041/SEC-035; media admission and limits; and GLM5Next load and serving boundaries. None of that is new in this PR. The added text, read via the patch excerpt, describes performance and scheduling behavior of speculative decode history. It does not change cache-scope derivation, encryption, attestation, authorization or billing. It introduces no new at-rest artifact. No regression or threat-model gap was identified. One point should be verified elsewhere: the carry/history plumbing must stay per-request, so assistant history is not mixed across concurrent rows (A-001, TB-007). The doc says it is appended per row in step order, but the SDK source is not supplied.
